remarks: Overlooking the 5th tee of Burning Tree Country Club with sweeping golf course views, this distinctive 6,330 SF, 5-bedroom, 4 1/2-bath residence comes to market for the first time in 49 years. Set on 2.15 private acres, the home blends mid-century modern style with sophistication and comfort. Walls of glass, soaring ceilings and abundant natural light draw the outdoors in, creating a seamless connection to the surrounding landscape. Every principal room captures golf course views. The open floor plan flows effortlessly through generously proportioned living spaces, ideal for families or downsizers seeking space without compromise. Highlights include a chef's kitchen with fireplace, breakfast room overlooking the pool and course, family room, and dining room designed to host large gatherings. The living room offers expansive walls for art and a fireside seating area, while the library with fireplace and wet bar provides a quiet retreat. The privately positioned primary suite is accompanied by 4 additional bedrooms, 2 ensuite. A lower-level playroom doubles as an office or exercise room. A newer roof, HVAC system, and whole-house generator enhance efficiency and comfort. Resort-style outdoor amenities include a free-form pool with cabana, DecoTurf tennis court, and multiple decks. The fenced backyard provides space for pets.
